paraphrase_notes: Directly supports that E1.31 transports DMX512A packets over an IP network and defines data format, addressing and network-management behavior; current revision supports IPv4 and IPv6.
applicability_notes: Protocol specification does not itself define every venue topology, VLAN plan, switch configuration or employer permission.
required_qualifier: Keep protocol scope separate from site/network configuration authority.

paraphrase_notes: Directly supports that Art-Net is an Ethernet/TCP-IP-suite protocol intended to transfer DMX512 data across standard networking and can address many DMX universes.
applicability_notes: Art-Net is an Artistic Licence specification rather than an ANSI/ESTA standard; exact implementation behavior is version-bound.
required_qualifier: Identify Art-Net as its own published protocol, not as ANSI E1.31/sACN.
